messages:
olivia: Draft of the launch blog is in Drive (internal link).

olivia: Quick ask for a fast pass by EOD: 1) one-line lead, 2) benchmark claim + conservative footnote, 3) hero + footer CTAs, 4) demo/webinar routing for NA vs EMEA. Spot anything risky? :eyes:

marc: I'll do headline + CTAs. Two tight lead options: A) 'Production LLM inference with predictable latency and unit economics' B) 'Ship LLM features faster with predictable inference.' Leaning A.

jen: Legal: benchmarks must include hardware and test window. Recommend: "up to 3.5x in internal performance benchmarks (see methodology)" and replace "our tests" with "internal performance benchmarks." Add dates and baseline config in the footnote; avoid guarantees.

olivia: Numbers from Dedicated alpha (A100n, mixed-precision) measured Mar 2026. I'll update the methodology link and use Jen's phrasing.

riley: Growth ops CTA plan:
- Hero primary: "Book a technical demo"
- Hero secondary: "View the performance brief"
- Footer: "Request trial access"
Routing: demo -> SDR by region; performance brief -> marketing nurture; trial -> product ops onboarding. EMEA SDR 08:00-18:00 CET, fallback to NA outside hours.

riley: Pasted small CSV for handoff:
```
region,segment,demo_type,owner,window
NA,SMB,Intro live,sd-na-01,09:00-11:00 ET
NA,Enterprise,Tech deep,sd-na-02,13:00-16:00 ET
EMEA,SMB,Recorded+book,sd-emea-01,09:00-12:00 CET
EMEA,Enterprise,Live deep,sd-emea-02,13:00-17:00 CET
APAC,Any,Recorded+local,sd-apac-01,Weekdays SGT
```

ops-bot: Reminder: Embargo until 2026-04-08T17:00:00Z. Set `embargo: true` and remove public links until release. :lock:

jen: Legal approves the revised footnote once methodology includes sequence lengths, batching, and baseline fp16 config. One wording tweak: use "internal performance benchmarks" consistently.

marc: I'll lock lead to option A and push CTAs A/B (70% demo / 30% brief). Design + ops tagged. Final check here by 17:00 UTC and then mark ready-for-design. :white_check_mark:
